problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: size 67 units
* Package Beta: size 47 units
* Package Gamma: size 51 units
* Package Delta: size 59 units
* Package Epsilon: size 34 units
* Package Zeta: size 33 units
* Package Eta: size 48 units
* Package Theta: size 44 units
* Package Iota: size 59 units
* Package Kappa: size 70 units
* Package Lambda: size 49 units
* Package Mu: size 65 units
* Package Nu: size 43 units
* Package Xi: size 54 units
* Package Omicron: size 34 units
* Package Pi: size 57 units
* Package Rho: size 32 units
* Package Sigma: size 32 units
* Package Tau: size 35 units
* Package Upsilon: size 53 units
* Package Phi: size 30 units
* Package Chi: size 48 units
* Package Psi: size 49 units
* Package Omega: size 33 units
* Package Arrow: size 30 units
* Package Star: size 32 units
* Package Box: size 69 units
* Package Diamond: size 32 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
